description: Back row: Ida O'Keeffe, Catherine O'Keeffe Klenert, Alexis O'Keeffe, Anita O'Keeffe Young. Front row: Catherine Klenert Krueger, and Eleanor Jane Young. Georgia O'Keeffe's younger siblings and their children. Handwritten on verso: My brother sisters and 2 nieces.
imageCaption: Unknown photographer. Ida O'Keeffe, Catherine O'Keeffe Klenert, Alexis O'Keeffe, Anita O'Keeffe Young, Catherine Klenert Krueger, and Eleanor Jane Young, ca. 1929. photographic print. Claudia O'Keeffe Papers. Georgia O'Keeffe Museum.
title: Ida O'Keeffe, Catherine O'Keeffe Klenert, Alexis O'Keeffe, Anita O'Keeffe Young, Catherine Klenert Krueger, and Eleanor Jane Young
